finding_status.evidence: Fix-up commit a2c6e5b89 extends useChatScroll to accept a `layoutDeps: DependencyList` parameter. The stick-to-bottom effect now includes `...layoutDeps` in its dependency array (src/pages/chat/components/ChatHistory/hooks/useChatScroll.tsx:63). ChatHistory passes `[tipIsVisible]` to it (src/pages/chat/components/ChatHistory/ChatHistory.tsx:63), so a tip appearance/dismissal now triggers scrollToBottom when shouldStickToBottom.current is true — the ~40px layout shift no longer strands the user above the visual bottom.

Fix-up commit a2c6e5b89 guards premiumTipKey against null-chat: it is only computed when both currentChat?.id and effectiveModel?.value exist (ChatHistory.tsx:51-52), otherwise it is null. The reset effect early-returns when premiumTipKey is null (ChatHistory.tsx:56), preserving dismissedPremiumTipKey across brief unmount/remount cycles. tipIsVisible also gates on premiumTipKey !== null to avoid rendering on transient null states.
